items.stem: Which cost is NOT relevant to a decision about a future special order?

options.rationale: Correct: sunk costs are past and unavoidable, so they are irrelevant to future decisions.

options.text: The incremental material cost of the order
options.rationale: Incremental material cost changes with the decision, so it is relevant.

options.text: Extra labour needed for the order
options.rationale: Additional labour is an incremental cost and is relevant.
Avoidable costs differ between options and are relevant.

items.explanation: Correct: sunk costs cannot be changed by the decision and are therefore irrelevant.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO inputs are required to compute the break-even point in units? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: fixed costs must be covered to break even.
Correct: break-even units equal fixed costs divided by contribution margin per unit.
Tax is not needed for a pre-tax break-even calculation.
Dividend policy is unrelated to break-even.

items.explanation: Correct: break-even units = fixed costs / contribution margin per unit.

items.stem: What is the contribution margin per unit?

options.text: Selling price per unit minus variable cost per unit
options.rationale: Correct: contribution margin is price less variable cost, the amount contributing to fixed costs and profit.

options.text: Selling price minus total cost per unit
options.rationale: That is profit per unit, not contribution margin.
That is fixed cost per unit, not contribution margin.

options.text: Revenue minus cost of goods sold
options.rationale: That is gross profit, not contribution margin.

items.explanation: Correct: contribution margin per unit is price minus variable cost per unit.
